name: Celcii PixiPen
tagline: A pen with custom electronics that lets you write in the air.
problem: The team wanted to write anywhere, without paper.
solution: An ESP32 on a custom PCB inside a pen tracks motion and sends strokes for display.
demo_moment: Team-described: write in the air and see the strokes.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Third Overall Hardware Hack” among 176 submissions.
A custom PCB built during the event.

lessons: Custom electronics in a familiar object impress hardware judges.
